notes.title: My Pleasure - Season 3: Release Date!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

Just dropping in to share some news – [b]"My Pleasure - Season 3"[/b] is all set for release on [b]March 29th[/b]. Alongside the main game, we're also rolling out an [b]Advanced Walkthrough[/b], [b]Wallpapers[/b], and the [b]Soundtrack[/b]. It's quite the package, and we're pretty excited to get it into your hands.

[h3]What to Look Forward To:[/h3]
This season is packed with about[b] 10-15 hours of gameplay[/b], which is pretty solid. You've got a bunch of different paths to explore, and it’s designed for multiple playthroughs. So, there's a lot to uncover based on the choices you make.

Here's the Scoop on the New Stuff:

[list]
[*] We’ve included over [b]5,000 images[/b]. Yeah, we’ve been busy.
[*] Added more than [b]500 animations[/b] to make things feel more alive.
[*] There are [b]37 new Steam Achievements[/b] for the achievement hunters out there.
[*] Expect a decent chunk of gameplay time, somewhere between 10 and 15 hours.
[*] The game features a mix of scenes with various characters – should keep things interesting.
[*] We've also put in a[b] Holiday Special Event[/b].
[*] Plus, there are plenty of [b]Extra Scenes[/b] and reasons to go through the game a few times.
[/list]


[h3]If this sounds like something you’d enjoy, [b]consider adding it to your wishlist[/b]. That way, you won't miss out on the release![/h3]

Tasty Pics Studio.
